โรงพยาบาลมีนโยบายที่แปลกและไม่เป็นมิตรกับลูกค้าที่ใช้สิทธิร่วมระหว่างสิทธิประกันสังคมร่วมกับประกันชีวิตคะ ระบบการสื่อสารกับคนไข้แย่ไม่ใหห้เกียรติ ล่าสุดนอนโรงพยาบาลจากการพบหมอเฉพาะทางด้านปอดกว่าจะได้คิวนัดต้องผ่านหมอทั่วไปเกือบ2เดือนแล้วและต้องไปนอนโรงพยาบาลใกล้บ้านมาก่อนแล้วจึงได้นัดหมอเฉพาะทางด้านอายุรกรรมและรออีกเกือบ2-3สัปดาห์จึงได้พบเฉพาะทางด้านปอดคุณหมอปอดสั่งแอดมินแต่บอกว่า ถ้าสิทธิ์ประกันสังคมคุณหมออาจไม่ใช่เจ้าของไข้อาจจะเป็นคุณหมอท่านอื่น เลยแจ้งคุณหมอไปว่ามีประกันชีวิตส่วนตัว ใช้ร่วมกันได้ไหมคุณหมอบอกใช้ร่วมกันได้ และคุณหมอสามารถเป็นเจ้าของไข้ได้จึงตัดสินใจใช้สิทธิ์ร่วม พอถึงวันติดตามอาการมีขัอความแจ้งนัดติดตามอาการ สามท่าน จึงโทรไปสอบถามกับเจ้าหน้าที่ว่าต้องไปเริ่มต้นอย่างไร ได้รับแจ้งว่าต้องเข้าระบบ ประกันสังคม ไปเจอหมอทั่วไปขึ้นอยู่ดุลพินิจของหมอทั่วไปว่าจะได้เจอหมอเจ้าของไข้หรือไม่ ท้ายสุดคือไม่ได้พบหมอเจ้าของไข้ จึงแจ้งโรงพยาบาลขอใช้สิทธิ์ประกันชีวิต เพราะมีประกันชีวิตแบบผู้ป่วยนอก  ผู้บริหารโรงพยาบาลแจ้งว่า ไม่อนุญาตให้ใช้ประกันชีวิต สามารถใช้สิทธิ์ประกันสังคมได้เท่านั้น แต่จะต้องเป็นไปตาม นโยบายและขั้นตอนของประกันสังคม ซึ่งพอถามว่าเพราะอะไรถึงไม่สามารถใช้ประกันชีวิตส่วนตัวในการพบหมอเจ้าของไข้ได้ กลับแจ้งว่าไม่มีคําตอบเป็นนโยบาย ขอพบผู้บริหารเพื่อขอทราบความแตกต่างการใช้สิทธิ์แต่ละอย่างแตกต่างกันอย่างไร ทางคนไข้จะได้ตัดสินใจเลือกแต่ก็แจ้งว่าไม่สามารถแจ้งข้อมูลให้ได้เป็นPDPAและพบผู้บริหารไม่ได้ ที่สําคัญอยู่ดี ๆ มีนัด เอ็กซเรย์ทางเดินอาหารแบบกลืนแป้ง ในวันที่3/8/69 โดยที่ทางผู้ป่วย ไม่ทราบเรื่องไม่ได้รับข้อความ ไม่ได้รับโทรศัพท์จากโรงพยาบาลเลย หรือใบนัดใดๆ แต่พอติดต่อตรงเวชระเบียบประกันสังคมกลับแจ้งว่าผู้ป่วยผิดนัด ไม่สามารถพบแพทย์ได้แล้ว ซึ่งเป็นคําตอบที่ไม่เคลียร์สําหรับผู้ป่วยมาก โดยเฉพาะการไม่สามารถพบแพทย์เจ้าของไข้และไม่สามารถลงทะทะเบียนพบแพทย์โดยใช้สิทธิประกันชีวิตหรือเงินสดได้ ปล. I came here in July looking for a serious approach to body recomposition at 51. Instead of generic advice, I got an objective baseline: a full InBody analysis and lab panel, and I left with a complete plan. Concrete calories and macros, TRT, and a GLP-1 (tirzepatide), all based on my actual numbers.

Four weeks later, measured on the same machine here: weight 89.4 to 86.5 kg, body fat 24.0 to 19.3 kg (26.8% to 22.3%), skeletal muscle 37.2 to 38.4 kg, and visceral fat level down from 10 to 8. Losing 4.7 kg of fat while actually gaining muscle is not something I expected at my age.

The daily work is mine. I cook every meal at home, weigh my food and train four times a week. But having a measured baseline, a real plan, and the same equipment to verify it four weeks later is what separates guessing from knowing.

On top of that, they have treated me extremely well every single time. Everything about this place is first class: the staff, the equipment, the follow-up. I'm confident I'll be coming here for my check-ups for many years to come. Highly recommended.

We travelled from Switzerland to Thailand because of the outstanding reputation of Dr. Kanit and Phyathai 2 Hospital. After extensive research and excellent recommendations, we believed we had chosen one of Thailand’s leading private hospitals.

Unfortunately, our experience on the morning of my wife’s surgery was deeply disappointing.

The admission process on Ward B (14th Floor – Aesthetic Surgery Private Unit) was handled by a nurse whose attitude was completely unacceptable. She barely acknowledged us, avoided eye contact, showed no empathy, provided no explanation while we were waiting, and made us feel as though we were an inconvenience rather than private patients.

To be clear: this review is not about waiting times. Delays can happen in any hospital. It is about the complete lack of professionalism, courtesy and compassion shown by the nurse who admitted my wife.

The situation became so upsetting that my wife seriously considered cancelling her surgery just moments before the procedure. I had to spend considerable time reassuring her and convincing her to continue because we still had confidence in Dr. Kanit’s medical expertise.

What made the situation even worse was that, when I politely asked the nurse for her name in order to report the incident, she refused to identify herself.

As someone who has spent many years as a CEO of major financial services companies in Europe, I understand what world-class customer service looks like. Respect, empathy and communication are not optional—especially in a premium private hospital where patients are facing major surgery.

The medical team may be excellent, and we sincerely hope my wife’s surgical outcome reflects that excellence. However, the behaviour we experienced from the nursing staff fell far below the standards that an international private hospital should uphold.

This experience has seriously damaged our confidence in the hospital and left us questioning whether we made the right decision by choosing Phyathai 2.

I hope the hospital management investigates this incident thoroughly and ensures that no future patient is treated in the way we were.

I had an excellent experience with Bangkok Fight Lab and its owner, Morgan. I originally applied for the Destination Thailand Visa (DTV) through the Los Angeles Embassy, which required a Sports Authority of Thailand (SAT) gym document. At the time, Fight Lab did not have this certification.

Morgan went above and beyond to help me. Knowing I was traveling soon, he immediately referred me to another gym so I wouldn’t lose time. At the same time, he personally went to the SAT and secured the required certification within just two days. On top of that, he refunded me the full 30,000 baht without hesitation.

This level of integrity, professionalism, and dedication is rare. Even though I couldn’t train at Fight Lab this time, Morgan’s reputation and the way he handled the situation make me want to return and train at his gym in the future. Highly recommended for anyone serious about Muay Thai and looking for a trustworthy gym in Thailand.

My husband and I traveled all the way from the United States to Bangkok for IVF treatment, and unfortunately, our experience with this clinic was extremely disappointing.

From the moment we arrived, the clinic felt dark, outdated, and not particularly clean. The location was also difficult to find and did not give us confidence compared to other fertility clinics we visited in Bangkok.

Communication was one of our biggest concerns. The doctor’s English was limited, making it difficult to fully understand our treatment plan. We often left appointments with more questions than answers because very little was explained about the procedures, medications, or next steps.

We also felt pressured into additional procedures and expenses without clear explanations. The medication costs were surprisingly high, and when we consulted another well-known fertility clinic in Bangkok, we were informed that the medications prescribed to us were relatively inexpensive medications being sold at a significant markup.

IVF is already an emotional, stressful, and expensive journey. Patients deserve transparency, accurate information, professional communication, and clear explanations. Unfortunately, we did not receive that here. We ultimately transferred our care elsewhere and had a much more positive experience.

Based on our experience, I would not recommend this clinic to anyone seeking IVF treatment in Bangkok.

I have been reaching out regarding a clinical emergency (reopened cavity) since last Friday (5 days ago). This is not a simple untreated lesion; this is a previously prepared tooth with exposed dentin and a high risk of pulpal involvement. Despite multiple messages, I physically visited the clinic yesterday and was promised a follow up message to schedule an appointment by noon today and I have been ignored. Leaving an open, drilled tooth exposed for 5+ days is clinical negligence that virtually guarantees a need for a root canal or extraction due to bacterial seeding.

I am now symptomatic with a secondary ear infection and respiratory cold directly linked to this untreated source. A holistic clinic that ignores a patient’s escalating bacterial load and fails to provide an emergency seal is a liability. I am moving my care to a facility that understands clinical urgency. Practitioners and patients requiring actual integrative care should look elsewhere.

I highly recommend the Body Adjust Chirovedic Clinic and Khun Natsarna’s chiropractic services. I developed a slight pinching pain in my right hip that caused me to stop my jogging routine. I could not resolve this issue with yoga stretching after a few days, so I made an appointment at the Body Adjust Chirovedic Clinic to get a diagnosis. Doctor Natsana has a very warm and welcoming personality, as she listened carefully to my situation and gave me a chiropractic examination. She clarified that my hip flexor muscles were weaker than my leg muscles, which was causing stiffness in my lower back, forward rotation of my hip, and tight psoas muscles. During our 2-hour session, she offered a wide variety of exercises to strengthen my core muscles with body weight and resistance bands, as well as using a cool pad after exercise to reduce inflammation. I have been practicing these techniques every morning for a week and am starting to see a slow, steady improvement. I am walking with less pain, and my lower back muscles are less tight.
